name: University of Memphis
oos_note: Public university. Official U of Memphis USBS Fee Schedule, Undergraduate 2025-26 Non-Resident (www.memphis.edu/usbs/fees/2526fees/ug_nonresident.pdf): non-resident charged per credit hour with no cap. Full-time 12 hrs/semester = $7,020 tuition + $960 university service fee = $7,980/semester total; annual (2 semesters) = $15,960 tuition & fees. Matches in-state basis (full-time tuition & fees).
